ctu2.sentence: Successful applicants receive a letter of sanction detailing the amount of financial assistance approved.

ctu1.sentence: The Ministry of Education oversees the implementation of this scheme.

ctu2.sentence: They are responsible for monitoring the utilization of funds and evaluating the outcomes of the supported events.

ctu1.sentence: Contact details for the Ministry of Education can be found on their official website.

ctu2.sentence: They provide assistance and guidance to institutions regarding the application process.
